messages:
olivia_csm: Hey team — I'm putting together a short customer-facing runbook for retention-risk accounts (low-touch). Goal: a 1-page ops checklist that CS reps can share with customers to mitigate renewal risk using prefill/caching/batching and streaming fallbacks. Any quick dos/don'ts we should include?
maya_cs: Love it. Keep it prescriptive. Tiered recommendations: 1) Prefill on login 2) Aggressive client-side caching for static prompts 3) Conservative batching windows for sync ops
jordan_se: agree. Add a small config snippet we can drop into our onboarding guide:
jordan_se: ```yaml
prefill:
  enabled: true
  strategy: incremental
  max_parallel: 3
cache:
  ttl: 45s
  scope: tenant
batching:
  target_ms: 40
  max_delay_ms: 120
streaming:
  enabled: true
  fallback_to_polling_after_ms: 2500
``` 
sam_eng: +1. Note: for low-touch customers we recommend `cache: ttl` >=30s to avoid cost spikes but not so long it hides regressions. Also call out `stale-while-revalidate` pattern.
laura_pm: Suggest an explicit step: "if renewal < 30d, enable warm pools + canary prompts". Also a template email snippet CS can send to customers with checks to run.
olivia_csm: Nice — can someone draft a 2-para customer note we can paste?
maya_cs: Draft below — short + actionable:
maya_cs: "Quick ops checklist to keep your tenant responsive and costs steady:
1) Enable prefill for common flows (login/home feed).
2) Use a tenant-scoped cache with `stale-while-revalidate` and TTL 30–60s.
3) Set batching target 30–50ms for sync calls; allow 100–150ms for non-critical batches.
4) Turn on streaming for UIs that show partial results; fallback to polling after 2.5s to avoid hangs.
If you see error spikes >5% or latency >500ms, toggle prefill off, reduce batch windows, and open a ticket with us."
sam_eng: I'll add an internal troubleshooting checklist: small set of queries to run, logs to fetch (`/api/v1/metrics?tenant=...&window=1h`), and a one-click support link.
oncall-bot: Incident note created: #CS-Retention-2025-42 — template added to ops playbooks.
olivia_csm: Perfect. I'll assemble a one-pager and share in the customer-resource repo. Thx everyone :rocket:
